Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In continuation to our letter dated October 9, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of the SEBI 
Listing Regulations, we hereby inform you that the audio recording of the Conference Call held today      
i.e., Friday, October 16, 2026 at 4:30 PM (IST) on the Company’s financial performance for the 2nd quarter 
and half year ended September 30, 2026 has been uploaded on the Company’s website within the 
stipulated timelines at https://www.dbcorpltd.com/financial-results.php. 
 
The link to access the said audio recording is: 
https://dbcorpltd.com/img/DB_Corp_Q2FY27_Earnings_Call_Audio.mp3  
 
Request you to kindly take the above information on records. 
 
Thanking you,
